description: This Java class 'LoanChargePaidByReadService' provides data access methods to retrieve 'LoanChargePaidBy' entities from the database, specifically fetching charge payment details by transaction IDs, using JPA Criteria API; it acts as a service layer component in the Fineract loan accounting module.

classes.name: LoanChargePaidByReadService
classes.description: A Spring-managed service component that provides methods to retrieve 'LoanChargePaidBy' entities based on transaction IDs, using JPA Criteria API for database querying.

methods.name: fetchLoanChargesPaidByDataTransactionId
methods.description: Converts a single transaction ID into a list and fetches corresponding 'LoanChargePaidByData' DTOs.

methods.name: fetchLoanChargesPaidByDataTransactionId
methods.description: Fetches 'LoanChargePaidByData' DTOs for a list of transaction IDs by querying the database.

methods.name: fetchLoanChargesPaidByTransactionId
methods.description: Performs database query to retrieve list of 'LoanChargePaidBy' entities that are associated with given transaction IDs.
